title: Symphunk — Observability Proof-of-Work
description: Live evidence from Symphunk's ObsAgent: one orchestrator, many agents, one Splunk.

options.query: search index=summary source="symphunk:evidence" | eval Status=case(status=="Resolved","Resolved ✓",status=="Escalated","Escalated ⚠",1=1,status) | eval Confidence=round(confidence,2) | rename title AS Title, severity AS Severity, recommended_action AS Action | eval Time=strftime(_time,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | table Time, Title, Severity, Status, Confidence, Action | sort - Time | head 20
search index=summary source="symphunk:evidence" | stats count AS Total
search index=summary source="symphunk:evidence" status=Resolved | stats count AS "Auto-Resolved"
search index=summary source="symphunk:evidence" | stats avg(confidence) AS c | eval "Avg Confidence"=round(c,2) | fields "Avg Confidence"
search index=summary source="symphunk:evidence" status=Escalated | stats count AS Escalated

options.markdown:
## Symphunk — One Conductor, Many Agents, One Splunk

Proof-of-work: Splunk alerts → `symphunk_ingest` action → KV incidents → ObsAgent investigates via MCP tools → evidence + confidence score → auto-resolve or escalate. All state lives in Splunk.
